entries.title: II Corinthians 6:1
segments: But working together, we also call on you not to receive the grace of God in vain.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:2
segments: (For He says, "In an acceptable time I heard you, and in a day of salvation, I helped you;" Behold, now [is] the accepted time. Behold, now [is] the day of salvation.)

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:3
segments: [We are] in nothing giving cause of stumbling, in no way, so that the ministry may not be blamed,

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:4
segments: but in everything commending ourselves as God's servants, in much patience, in troubles, in emergencies, in distresses,

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:5
segments: in stripes, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:6
segments: in pureness, in knowledge, in long-suffering, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in love unfeigned,

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:7
segments: in [the] word of truth, in [the] power of God, through the weapons of righteousness on the right [hand] and on the left,

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:8
segments: through glory and dishonor, through evil report and good report; as deceivers and [yet] true;

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:9
segments: as unknown and [yet] well known; as dying and, behold, we live; as chastened and not killed;

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:10
segments: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, [yet] possessing all things.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:11
segments: O Corinthians, our mouth is opened to you, our heart has been enlarged.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:12
segments: You are not restrained in us, but you are restrained in your own affections.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:13
segments: But for the same reward, (I speak as to children), you also be enlarged.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:14
segments: Do not be unequally yoked together [with] unbelievers; for what fellowship does righteousness [have] with lawlessness? And what partnership does light [have] with darkness?

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:15
segments: And what agreement does Christ [have] with Belial? Or what part does a believer [have] with an unbeliever?

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:16
segments: And what agreement does a temple of God [have] with idols? For you are the temple of [the] living God, as God has said, "I will dwell in them and walk among [them]; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people."

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:17
segments: Therefore come out from among them and be separated, says the Lord, and do not touch the unclean [thing]. And I will receive you

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:18
segments: and I will be a Father to you, and you shall be My sons and daughters, says [the] Lord Almighty.
